purpose: Single declarative definition of the Syslog header grammar. The browser TypeScript and the generated Ruby Fragment take their structured-path header regular expressions, capture names and semantic limits from the code generated from this file (scripts/grammar/generate-grammar.mjs). Not migrated yet (Issue #249 W4, W5): the Generic Structural sites and the Python Multi-Pass engine, which still carry hand-written copies; those copies are counted and ratcheted down by scripts/verification/grammar-duplication-ratchet.mjs.
authority: RFC 3164 section 4.1 (PRI, HEADER = TIMESTAMP HOSTNAME, MSG = TAG CONTENT)
RFC 5424 section 6 (HEADER = PRI VERSION SP TIMESTAMP SP HOSTNAME SP APP-NAME SP PROCID SP MSGID; VERSION = NONZERO-DIGIT 0*2DIGIT; only VERSION 1 is defined)
portability: Token patterns use only the regular-expression subset that means the same thing in ECMAScript, Ruby 2.4 (Onigmo) and Python re: literal ASCII, bracket classes with ranges, bounded and +*? quantifiers, (?: ) groups, (?! ) lookahead and alternation. Shorthand classes, '.', anchors, back-references and lazy or possessive quantifiers are rejected by the generator because their meaning differs between the runtimes ('.' excludes U+2028 in ECMAScript but not in Ruby; \d is Unicode-aware in Python).

BSD_HOSTNAME.semantic: 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters without '=' and not ending in ':'. A token that contains '=' or opens a structured body ('{', 'CEF:', 'LEEF:') is body content, and a token that ends in ':' is a TAG, never a host name: a line whose HOSTNAME is omitted must not lose its first field or its TAG into the header.

REST.semantic: Remainder of the single physical line

STRUCTURED_BODY.semantic: A body that starts with an explicit structure opener (JSON object, CEF, LEEF or key=)

RFC5424_VERSION.semantic: must be listed in semantics.rfc5424SupportedVersions; any other syntactically valid VERSION is an unsupported, not-parsed record in every consumer

rfc3164_hostless.description: [<PRI>]Mmm dd hh:mm:ss structured-body (HOSTNAME omitted by the sender)

rfc5424.description: <PRI>VERSION SP TIMESTAMP SP HOSTNAME SP APP-NAME SP PROCID SP MSGID SP (STRUCTURED-DATA [SP MSG])
